details.description: Speechmatics' Enhanced operating point for real-time (streaming) speech-to-text, delivered over a WebSocket connection. It is the higher-accuracy of Speechmatics' two real-time models: the maker recommends it for single-language audio such as medical, legal or subtitling work where accuracy matters more than raw throughput. Enhanced supports 55+ languages and language packs (each covering multiple accents and dialects), plus bilingual packs and translation to/from English for most languages. It is feature-identical to Speechmatics' Standard operating point and differs only in its accuracy/speed trade-off.
advantages: Speechmatics documents Enhanced as delivering the highest accuracy of its two real-time operating points, recommending it for single-language work such as medical, legal or subtitling transcription.
Supports 55+ languages and language packs, each covering multiple accents and dialects, plus bilingual packs and translation to/from English for most languages.
Real-time speaker diarization labels up to 50 speakers by default, configurable up to 100.
Also supports custom dictionaries, turn detection for voice assistants, and speaker identification through voice-profile enrollment on streaming audio.
disadvantages: Automatic language detection is available only with Speechmatics' Batch transcription, not Realtime, so the language or language pack must be set explicitly for streaming audio.
Standard, Speechmatics' other real-time operating point, is documented as faster and prioritizing throughput; Enhanced trades some speed for its higher accuracy.
use_cases: Voice assistants that use turn detection to know when a speaker has finished talking

notes: The catalog id 'real-time-enhanced' is Speechmatics' Enhanced operating point used with the Realtime API (the older `operating_point` config field is being superseded by a `model` field per the docs, but Enhanced itself is not deprecated). No 0-100 accuracy benchmark for this exact operating point was found on the maker's pages, so evaluations is empty; a competitor error-rate comparison on the product page was not tied to a specific operating point, so it was left out rather than risk misattributing it to Enhanced or Standard.
